node.title: Inventory Management
node.description: Functional testing suite for the product catalog, including sorting, filtering, and product detail validation.

node.title: All products displayed on inventory page
node.description: Validate that the inventory page loads and displays all available products.
node.preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user.
node.postconditions: All 6 products are visible on the inventory page.

node.expected_result: Page loads successfully. 6 product cards are displayed.

node.action: Verify each product card contains: image, name, description, price and Add to cart button
node.expected_result: All product cards are complete with all required elements.

node.title: Sort products by Name (A to Z)
node.description: Validate that products are sorted alphabetically in ascending order.
node.preconditions: User is on the inventory page.

node.action: Select "Name (A to Z)" from the sort dropdown
node.expected_result: Products reorder alphabetically from A to Z.

node.action: Verify the first product name comes before the last alphabetically
node.expected_result: Order is correct. "Sauce Labs Backpack" appears before "Sauce Labs Zip Money Wallet".

node.title: Sort products by Name (Z to A)
node.description: Validate that products are sorted alphabetically in descending order.
node.preconditions: User is on the inventory page.

node.action: Select "Name (Z to A)" from the sort dropdown
node.expected_result: Products reorder alphabetically from Z to A.

node.action: Verify the first product name comes after the last alphabetically
node.expected_result: Order is correct. "Sauce Labs Zip Money Wallet" appears first.

node.title: Sort products by Price (low to high)
node.description: Validate that products are sorted by ascending price.
node.preconditions: User is on the inventory page.
node.postconditions: Products displayed from cheapest to most expensive.

node.action: Select "Price (low to high)" from the sort dropdown
Verify the first product has the lowest price and the last has the highest
node.expected_result: Price order is correct. $7.99 appears first, $49.99 appears last.

node.title: Sort products by Price (high to low)
node.description: Validate that products are sorted by descending price.
node.preconditions: User is on the inventory page.
node.postconditions: Products displayed from most expensive to cheapest.

node.action: Select "Price (high to low)" from the sort dropdown
Verify the first product has the highest price
node.expected_result: Price order is correct. $49.99 appears first.

node.title: Product detail page displays correct information
node.description: Validate that clicking a product opens its detail page with accurate data.
node.preconditions: User is on the inventory page.
node.postconditions: Product detail page loaded with correct data.

node.action: Click on any product name or image
node.expected_result: User is redirected to the product detail page (/inventory-item.html).

node.action: Verify the detail page contains: image, name, description, price and Add to cart button
node.expected_result: All product details match those shown on the inventory page.
User is returned to the inventory page.

node.title: Inventory not accessible after logout
node.description: Validate that a logged out user cannot access the inventory page directly.
node.preconditions: User has logged out. No active session.
node.postconditions: Access denied. User redirected to login page.

node.action: After logout, navigate directly to https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html
node.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page. Inventory content is not displayed.

node.title: Visual glitch user displays broken images
node.description: Validate that visual_user sees broken product images, confirming the glitch behavior.
node.preconditions: User is logged in as visual_user.
node.postconditions: Broken images detected on inventory page.

node.action: Login with visual_user credentials and navigate to inventory
node.expected_result: At least one product image fails to load or displays incorrectly.
